author: meax
body: I'm here to reapply. 4 days ago I got a perm ban for ban evading, which I didn't know what it was at the time. I know you won't care, and I'm going to say it again, I joined Minecraft due to Personal Turmoil. My life isn't amazing and if you unban me you'll make me happy. I'm not trying to be desperate. I'm sorry for causing you unconvince.

title: Re-appeal

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

You are not going to be appealed. I have chosen not to appeal you because you ban evaded twice.It is a a possibility that you will be appealed in a few months, but for now you will not be appealed. 

Cheers!
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
